packet.title: EXPath File (design and implementation)
packet.summary: Implements the EXPath File Module 4.0 through sxml_file_system, a host interface in the processor configuration that is off by default; the CLI implements it over POSIX behind --allow-file-access.

item.p: Specifications: EXPath File Module 4.0, as the QT4 expath-file set tests it (namespace http://expath.org/ns/file; file:exists, file:list, file:read-text, file:write, file:create-dir, file:delete, file:path-to-uri, and the others; the file: errors).
Replaces: the functions are absent (XPST0017), and supports-file-library is false.

Mechanism: library code never touches the file system. A host interface does, next to the resolver and the clock: a file system with an operations table (read, write, append, list, stat, create, delete, move; each with at most three parameters, using request structs). The functions are nondeterministic, and evaluation order is the evaluator's. Off by default: the null file system makes every function raise file:io-error.
Header: processor.h, additive: sxml_file_system in the processor configuration, with a record.
CLI: implements the interface over POSIX and Windows. It is off unless --allow-file-access is given (owner question 7).
After: 7.2 (in a browser the feature is never linked).
Owns: new src/function_library_file.c, and the CLI's platform file (single hunks).
Size: 20–30 KB, none in the JavaScript package.

Gate: ≥ 90 % of the 271. Done 2026-10-19 (): expath-file 270 of 270 (XQ40) and 267 of 267 (XP40; 3 cases are XQuery-only); fn-system-properties' file case passes. About 66 KB native, none in the JavaScript modules. The CLI's Windows file system is not written yet.
